name: Appointment
description: Represents a scheduled or requested patient appointment with a doctor.

attributes.name: patientId
attributes.description: ID of the patient for this appointment (references Patient.idOfUser).

attributes.name: doctorId
attributes.description: ID of the doctor for this appointment (references Doctor.idOfUser).

attributes.name: dateTime
attributes.description: The scheduled date and time of the appointment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current status of the appointment.

attributes.name: reasonForVisit
attributes.description: The patient's stated reason for the visit.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Internal notes about the appointment, typically added by the doctor or admin.

attributes.name: durationMinutes
attributes.description: The planned duration of the appointment in minutes.
